mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analyzed_songs ( id, youtube_video_raw_id, youtube_video_id, song_id, status, message, duration_seconds, bpm, energy, danceability, loudness, musical_key, musical_scale, spectral_centroid, zero_crossing_rate, analyzed_at ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{youtubeVideoRawId}, #{youtubeVideoId}, #{songId}, #{status}, #{message}, #{durationSeconds}, #{bpm}, #{energy}, #{danceability}, #{loudness}, #{musicalKey}, #{musicalScale}, #{spectralCentroid}, #{zeroCrossingRate}, #{analyzedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE song_id = VALUES(song_id), status = VALUES(status), message = VALUES(message), duration_seconds = VALUES(duration_seconds), bpm = VALUES(bpm), energy = VALUES(energy), danceability = VALUES(danceability), loudness = VALUES(loudness), musical_key = VALUES(musical_key), musical_scale = VALUES(musical_scale), spectral_centroid = VALUES(spectral_centroid), zero_crossing_rate = VALUES(zero_crossing_rate), analyzed_at = VALUES(analyzed_at)
